academic_qualification: Pass in 2nd PUC / 10+2 / Higher Secondary or equivalent examination.
compulsory_subjects: Physics and Mathematics, along with Chemistry, Biotechnology, Computer Science, Biology or Electronics as an optional subject. The supplied admission information states that Chemistry can be replaced by one of the listed alternatives.

minimum_marks.general: Minimum 45% aggregate in the core/optional subjects.
minimum_marks.reserved: Minimum 40% aggregate for SC, ST, Category-1 and OBC candidates; the stated relaxation applies to Karnataka candidates belonging to these categories.

accepted_entrance_exams.name: KCET
accepted_entrance_exams.details: Karnataka Common Entrance Test; CET Code: E123

admission_routes.process: Filled through KCET counselling conducted by KEA. Candidates participate in KEA option entry, complete document verification at a designated Helpline Centre and proceed through seat allotment.
Filled through online counselling managed by COMEDK UGET.
Handled directly by the college admissions office. The supplied information states that PCM aggregate eligibility rules still apply.

KCET / COMEDK / JEE / KRLMPCA rank card and admission order, as applicable
Caste / Income certificate (if claiming SC, ST, Category-1 or OBC reservation/relaxation)
Aadhaar card or government-issued photo ID
